authorization: User authorizes the notified same-data/input/network direct regression versus existing DQN. Offline only.
source: Original GRID100 train prefixes, GRID102 states/normalization/price, GRID103 gamma0 DQN checkpoints. GRID106 cases diagnostic only.

features.normalization: Training reachable states only, each date equal total weight; clipped standardized features in[-20,20].
features.station: Group locked to initial incumbent station, aliases respected. Learned policy does not change global search or station choice.

architecture: Exactly original SB3 QNetwork:41 ->64 ReLU ->64 ReLU ->2;6978 parameters, paired initial seed.

training.optimizer: Original SB3 Adam parameter groups, learning_rate0.0003, max_grad_norm10.
training.loss: torch smooth_l1_loss beta1, mean over32 states x2 action values; same scalar target budget as DQN64 sampled action targets.
training.targets: STOP=0, CONTINUE=(next best-admissible float32 reward gain - unchanged per-query fee*next_queries)/old gain_scale.
training.sampling: Equal date, equal starting prefix within date, uniform reachable position within prefix. Same initial task masses as DQN; replaces policy-dependent visitation/replay with complete paid-feedback coverage.
training.fitting: Exactly3 fits; final7250 updates only, no validation early stop/checkpoint choice or seed selection.
training.intentionally_changed: Complete known-action labels and state coverage replace exploration/replay. This package cannot isolate sampling from full supervision separately.

evaluation.primary: Four-date macro search net utility versus paired/all3 old gamma0 DQN and BATCH1; report all dates and seeds.
evaluation.secondary: Train/validation positive misses, negative continues, value RMSE, gain capture/query fraction, single/multi horizons and physical-call-balanced utility.
evaluation.critical: Postfit fixed3 contexts: original March108, original March552, RF-path March552. No added labels, fit weights, feature changes or rules from those cases.
evaluation.interpretation: Training mechanism evidence only if mean train date-macro sign regret falls and >=2/3 paired validation utility differences positive; no same-quality physical claim. BATCH1 remains a mandatory independent comparator.

limits: No new observations/forecasts/physical steps/scenarios, price sweeps, positive-class oversampling, larger nets, DQN retraining, final-test materialization, or automatic closed-loop follow-up. Exposed development dates and correlated prefixes, not independent confirmation.
